description: Call AWS Bedrock's Converse API directly (boto3, not a litellm passthrough) once per row of an upstream DataFrame, optionally validating the JSON response against a declared output_schema and adding one output column per schema property. Supports text and raw-bytes image input.

inputs.description: One row per item to send to Bedrock, read from upstream_asset_key via input_column.

outputs.description: The upstream DataFrame with new column(s) appended -- one per output_schema property, or a single raw-text column when output_schema is unset.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Dagster asset key emitted by this component.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame with one row per item to send to Bedrock.

input_column.label: Input Column
input_column.description: Column holding the input -- raw text (input_type='text') or a path to an image file (input_type='image').

input_type.label: Input Type
input_type.description: 'text': input_column is sent as the prompt's text content. 'image': input_column is a path to an image file, read and sent as a raw-bytes image content block.

image_format.label: Image Format
image_format.description: Override the image format Bedrock is told to expect. Unset = inferred from the file extension.

model_id.label: Model ID
model_id.description: Bedrock model ID for the Converse API, e.g. 'qwen.qwen3-vl-235b-a22b' (vision-capable Qwen3) or 'qwen.qwen3-235b-a22b-v1:0' (text-only).

aws_region.label: AWS Region
aws_region.description: AWS region for the bedrock-runtime client.

prompt_template.label: Prompt Template
prompt_template.description: Prompt sent to the model. For input_type='text', '{input}' is replaced with the row's input_column value; the literal text is used as-is otherwise (e.g. for input_type='image', where the image itself is the primary content and this is an instruction).

output_schema.label: Output Schema
output_schema.description: JSON schema (with 'properties') the model's JSON response is validated against. One output column is added per property; missing or schema-invalid responses fill those columns with None. Leave unset to store the raw text response in output_column instead.

output_column.label: Output Column
output_column.description: Column name for the raw text response when output_schema is unset. Ignored (schema properties become the output columns instead) when output_schema is set.

min_valid_rate.label: Min Valid Rate
min_valid_rate.description: Only used when output_schema is set: minimum fraction of rows whose response must validate against output_schema. Emits a blocking (ERROR) or non-blocking (WARN) 'output_schema_valid_rate' check per min_valid_rate_severity. Leave unset for no check.

min_valid_rate_severity.label: Min Valid Rate Severity
min_valid_rate_severity.description: Severity of the output_schema_valid_rate check when min_valid_rate is set.

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Return deterministic synthetic Converse responses instead of calling AWS Bedrock. Set false for a real account.

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column
partition_date_column.description: Upstream column holding each row's date, used to filter to the current partition's rows when time-partitioned. Unset = no row filtering.

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one Dagster run. 'multi_run' launches one run per partition (optionally capped via Backfill Max Partitions Per Run). Leave empty for Dagster's default. Ignored when no partitioning is configured.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

name: Bedrock Converse Asset
